title: Receptor internalization assay to probe for agonist binding to CXCR2
protocol: Cultivate HEK293-CXCR2 cells at a density of 10^5 cells/well in a 12-well plate using 10%FCS/DMEM culture medium overnight.
Change the medium to DMEM containing 0.5% FCS.
Treat the cells with CXCL8 or rMIF for 45 min at 37°C.
Remove the medium and wash the cells once with cold acidic glycine buffer and twice with cold PBS.
Stain the cells with mouse anti-human CXCR2 antibody diluted 1:500 in PBS containing 1% FCS, or isotype control, for 45 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells three times with cold PBS.
Incubate the cells with FITC-conjugated anti-mouse antibody for 30 min at 4°C.
Analyse the fluorescence intensity by FACS.
Calculate percent of receptor internalization from the relative fluorescence intensity using the provided formula.
